description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI, testing its API endpoints such as 'getOne' and checking that methods like 'update', 'delete' are not implemented. It uses test data and mocks to verify API behavior within OrangeHRM's Attendance API module.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPITest
classes.description: This class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase to provide functional tests specifically for the AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI, covering the 'getOne' API method and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the API with various test cases, asserting that the API returns valid responses as per test data.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing the 'getOne' method, pulling test cases from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'update' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that getting validation rules for update throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'delete' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that getting validation rules for delete throws a 'not implemented' exception.
